EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Heh heh.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} We got a good crew here.
Oughta play some ball sometime!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Heh heh.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} İyi ekip olduk. Bir ara
top oynamalıyız!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Este bote no está hecho para llevar
a tanta gente. ¡Haced hueco, atunes!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Harrr, ihr Landratten!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Macht mal
etwas mehr Platz für euren Käpten!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}You boys known each other long?
Lifelong pals, are ye? Best buds?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Alors, les gars ? Ça fait longtemps
qu'vous vous connaissez ?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Siz çocuklar uzun zamandır mı
tanışıyorsunuz? Çocukluk arkadaşı mı?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Nothin' like the friendship 'tween
good mates, eh?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ça manque d'une touche de
féminité par ici...{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}L'amicizia è meglio di un bel
pangasio fritto, te lo dico io!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Na, Männer?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Treibt euch die Lust
am Abenteuer auf die Insel?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}İyi dostların arkadaşlığı gibisi yok,
değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}You men seem stuck together like
the barnacles on me hull!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Los hombres tienen que mantenerse
unidos, cual tortuga a su concha.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Mi sembrate più attaccati
di una cozza allo scoglio!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Siz çocuklar teknemin gövdesindeki
midyeler gibi birbirinize yapışmışsınız!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Du hast ganz schöne Muckis,
{{TAG:0011:0000:0100}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wie 'n echter Matrose!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}We oughta have a guys' night out
one o' these days!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}On devrait s'faire une soirée entre
hommes un de ces jours !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
